name: trade_journey_links_conflicts_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-234 — journal origin attribution and conflict detection. A read that returned no result set
(db_adapter._execute swallows every SQL error and returns None) is a gap, never an empty store: a missing
trade_recommendation_links table reads as `link_status: unavailable` with the migration named, not as `ok` with
`no recommendation was recorded`. A closed round trip is one lot; the CIO book's position_status and the re-entry
desk's CURRENTLY HELD are per symbol, so those two conflicts only fire when the holdings snapshot no longer holds
the symbol (None = holdings not read, which hides nothing). Fakes only: no database, no network, no production state.
